runtimeVersions.observedBy: root acceptance and S00 command catalog

exports.factory: makeLearningService(store: AgentStoreService, options?: LearningServiceOptions) returns a captured run(LearningInput) Effect<LearningOutput, AgentStoreFailure>
exports.layers: LearningService.layer and LearningService.layerWith(options) require AgentStore; runLearning requires LearningService
options: context: selected caller scope, window, tool/source/metric versions, workflow and coverage conditions, origin
resolveContext: optional lazy Effect provider used only for fresh evaluation or record candidate search; no startup, read or durable retry scope resolution

behavior: One service handles list, get, record, evaluate and supersede through the frozen AgentStore ports only.
Authored investigations retain open, concluded and awaiting-evidence states with immutable revision history.
Lesson states are proposed, supported-within-scope, contradicted and superseded. Support and contradiction are projections of append-only evaluations for the selected authored revision.
Current-revision counterevidence wins over support while both evidence chains remain reachable. Unavailable or incompatible citations prevent current supported recall.
Generic evaluation targets support both investigations and lessons. Independent evaluations of a pinned historical revision survive later author updates and concurrent appends.
Record updates and supersession use expected revision and preserve parent lineage. Keyed payload retries use durable storage receipts; changed payloads conflict.
Exact evaluation lookup recovers idempotent retries even beyond 100 newer evaluations or after cited evidence disappears.
Get expands lesson, investigation or evaluation references, including explicit authored revisions; focused evaluation retrieval returns its parent record and one requested evaluation.

List uses indexed scoped bounded storage selection, ranks applicability and evidence compatibility before recency within the selected page, and returns compact summaries with clipping disclosure, reference counts and drilldown handles.

Near-duplicate record suggestions compare normalized lexical token sets in one indexed selected-scope page of at most 25 records. Matching uses same kind, repository and definition/tool/source versions; at most eight references return, with bounds and unknown skipped-search disclosure. Distinct and opposing claims remain separate.
Canonical retained bases determine origin mix and coverage. Fixture, replay or synthetic observations, including mixed origin evidence, cannot support live lessons.
Fresh evaluations require the caller's selected repository context. Reference visibility is independently resolved under that scope; wider applicability never grants wider citation visibility.
Scope-only recall discloses unknown version, workflow or coverage compatibility and cannot return verified supported claims.
Stored and returned authored prose reuses existing credential redaction and remains inert data. Learning never executes commands, changes consent or alters accounting policy.
No direct database access, dependency installation, VCS writes, shared barrel edits or whole-workspace validation were performed by this owner.
retentionAndDisclosure: Authored records and append-only evaluations are retained through the storage owner; this service performs no automatic prose eviction or deletion.
Generation-bound unavailable, stale, withheld and over-budget citations remain explicit rather than replaced with invented evidence.
Withheld or unavailable evaluation citations remove origin and coverage metadata from the caller's returned evaluation and add a visibility disclosure.
Export and deletion remain operation-service responsibilities and do not follow implicitly from learning retrieval or applicability.

behavior.evidence: Includes production replay-port close/reopen, exact historical author revision retrieval, concurrent evaluation append, CAS retry reuse and canonical found/missing/withheld citations. Focused transitions prove earlier support does not carry across authored revision updates and deliberate production source replacement deletes a cited event, tombstones its retained basis and withdraws support while preserving learning and evaluations. Labelled injected-port cases also verify dynamic cited basis artifact deletion.

validation.typecheck: Root owns the core compiler queue; worker-reported service errors from the queue were repaired.

limits: Authored criterion and outcome text remain reports by the author; canonical evidence checks do not automatically prove an arbitrary natural-language criterion.
Causal support is unavailable in v1. Causal-criterion evaluations may remain inconclusive; descriptive associations explicitly do not establish saved time or correctness.
Similarity suggestions are lexical and bounded, not semantic equivalence or automatic merging.
Ranking applies within each bounded indexed candidate page rather than promising a globally sorted whole store.
Bounded history with unseen evaluations cannot establish support. Exact evaluation drilldown and explicit higher limits are available.
This module's observed integration uses a labelled replay store, not selected live private evidence.
